module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading

checkpoints.title_en: Formal email, the last pairs, and government

questions.prompt_en: अनुपस्थित is built how?
options: It is not built from parts
questions.explanation_en: अन- is the form the prefix takes before a vowel, which is the rule from level 12.

questions.question_en: Which is the everyday partner of अनुमति?
questions.explanation_en: इजाज़त दीजिए is what you say before leaving somebody's house. Both are feminine, so this pair matches.

questions.prompt_en: What is unusual about शिकायत?
options: It is only used in writing
It has no formal or casual partner — it covers the whole range
questions.explanation_en: The mirror image of उपलब्ध at level 18, which had no casual partner. Some words occupy the whole situation axis alone.

questions.prompt_en: तत्काल is built from which two parts?
options: तत् plus काल — at that very time
questions.explanation_en: The same काल as in आपातकाल on the level 14 emergency sign.

questions.prompt_en: स्वीकृति, प्रगति, शक्ति, नीति — what do they share?
options: All feminine, because of the -ति suffix
questions.explanation_en: -ति is the fourth abstract-noun suffix in the module, after -आई, -ई and -ता, and like them it is reliably feminine.

questions.prompt_en: कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता means what?
options: There is no difference at all
questions.explanation_en: Literally no difference falls. Learn it whole — it is one of the commonest sentences in the language.

questions.prompt_en: क़िस्मत and भाग्य mean the same. Which is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: The seventh mismatched pair. And भाग्य takes the compounds — भाग्यशाली, दुर्भाग्य — where क़िस्मत builds nothing.

questions.question_en: Which word names an honour that is formally conferred?
questions.explanation_en: You can lose your इज़्ज़त; you cannot lose a सम्मान once it has been given.

questions.prompt_en: चुनाव, बदलाव, दबाव, बहाव — what does the -आव suffix produce?
questions.explanation_en: The first noun-building suffix in the module that does not produce feminines.

questions.prompt_en: अर्थव्यवस्था ends in -आ. What gender is it?
options: feminine, because Sanskrit -आ nouns are a feminine class
questions.explanation_en: व्यवस्था, समस्या, चर्चा, घोषणा, प्रतीक्षा — the single most reliable gender trap in Hindi.

questions.prompt_en: मंत्री ends in -ी. What gender is it?
options: masculine — it joins आदमी, पानी and the agent nouns
questions.explanation_en: The mirror of the -आ feminines in the level before. Both endings mislead, in opposite directions.

questions.question_en: Which word for a court would appear on the building itself?
questions.explanation_en: न्याय plus आलय — the place suffix from level 8. अदालत is what people say and कोर्ट is what lawyers say.

questions.prompt_en: Which prefix negates क़ानूनी?
questions.explanation_en: ग़ैरक़ानूनी. ग़ैर- attaches to Urdu-side words as अ- attaches to Sanskrit-side ones.

questions.prompt_en: How is a loanword's gender decided in Hindi?
options: There is no rule — it is assigned and must be learned
questions.explanation_en: बजट masculine, टिप feminine, स्क्रीन feminine, स्कूल masculine. Level 42 refines this into a default and a list of exceptions.

questions.prompt_en: What is the difference between संसद and सांसद?
options: संसद is the building; सांसद is the session
संसद is parliament; सांसद is a member of it
questions.explanation_en: One long vowel between an institution and a person, and easy to miss in fast speech.

questions.context_en: A report reads: कुछ निवासियों का आरोप है कि टंकी की सफ़ाई महीनों से नहीं हुई। समिति के सचिव ने इस आरोप से इनकार किया।
options: That two sides disagree, and it takes neither
questions.explanation_en: आरोप and इनकार are the standard news pairing. The report attributes both and adjudicates nothing.

questions.prompt_en: प्रतिशत is built from which two parts?
questions.explanation_en: The same प्रति as on the level 7 parking sign, now compounded.

questions.prompt_en: गिरावट, सजावट, थकावट — what does -आवट produce?
questions.explanation_en: Set it beside -आव from level 34, which builds masculines from verbs. Same source, opposite gender.

questions.context_en: A report reads: शहर के ग्राहक इस गिरावट से ख़ुश हैं। पर किसानों का कहना है कि उन्हें नुक़सान हो रहा है।
questions.question_en: Why does the report include both?
options: The same price fall benefits buyers and harms sellers
questions.explanation_en: A price has two sides, and the convention is to give both without choosing.

questions.context_en: A survey report gives: साठ प्रतिशत रोज़ बस या मेट्रो से चलते हैं। पैंतीस प्रतिशत अपनी गाड़ी का प्रयोग करते हैं।
questions.question_en: What can you work out about the rest?
options: Five per cent do not travel
About five per cent are unaccounted for, and the report does not say how they travel
questions.explanation_en: Noticing what a set of figures leaves out is a different reading skill from locating one.

questions.prompt_en: Which is the Hindi oblique plural of ऐप?
questions.explanation_en: ऐपों में. ऐप्स is the English plural and also heard — the same split as फ़ोल्डरों and फ़ोल्डर्स in Module 12.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb goes with पासवर्ड?
questions.explanation_en: पासवर्ड डालना, and the same verb for नंबर, ओटीपी and पिन. लिखना would mean writing it down somewhere.

questions.prompt_en: Which of these English loanwords is masculine in Hindi?
questions.explanation_en: The default for a consonant-final English noun is masculine, and the feminines are a learnable list. Every -ing word is feminine.

questions.prompt_en: डेटा ends in -आ. Why is it masculine when घोषणा is feminine?
options: The -आ feminines are a Sanskrit class; loanwords follow the masculine default
questions.explanation_en: Two different systems meeting in one ending.

questions.prompt_en: फ़ाइल डाउनलोड ___ रही है — which verb?
questions.explanation_en: होना when the thing undergoes the action, करना when somebody does it. The pair covers most borrowed verbs.

questions.prompt_en: Which postposition goes with सोशल मीडिया?
questions.explanation_en: पर, like फ़ोन पर and टीवी पर. में would put you inside it.

questions.prompt_en: What does adding -आ to निपटना do?
questions.explanation_en: निपटना becomes निपटाना. Hindi has dozens of such pairs — बनना and बनाना, उलझना and उलझाना.

questions.question_en: Which verb means to put something off, with a hint that it is deliberate?
questions.explanation_en: A committee स्थगित करती है an event; a person टालता है a difficult conversation. टालमटोल is the noun.

questions.prompt_en: What does the prefix सु- mean?
questions.explanation_en: सुविधा, सुरक्षा, सुंदर, सुलझना — and its opposite दुर्- gives दुर्भाग्य and दुर्घटना.

questions.question_en: Which verb takes only feelings as its object?
questions.explanation_en: नाराज़गी जताना, संदेह जताना. Facts take बताना and visible things take दिखाना.

checkpoints.title_en: The last news, the first narratives

questions.prompt_en: नियुक्ति, आपूर्ति, स्वीकृति, स्थिति — what do they share?
options: All feminine, and all common in news writing
questions.explanation_en: Once you notice how many -ति nouns there are, a great deal of news Hindi becomes predictable.

questions.prompt_en: समझौता is built on which verb?
questions.explanation_en: An agreement is a coming-to-an-understanding — which is also why समझौता करना can mean to compromise.

questions.prompt_en: शिलान्यास and उद्घाटन are not the same. What is the difference?
options: शिलान्यास starts a building; उद्घाटन opens it
questions.explanation_en: Confusing them misreads the stage a project is at by a year or more.

questions.prompt_en: शिक्षक and शिक्षिका, लेखक and लेखिका — which suffixes are these?
questions.explanation_en: The same -क that gave प्रेषक at level 30, now with its feminine counterpart.

questions.context_en: A narrative reads: गाँव में सुबह जल्दी नींद खुल जाती थी ... उन दिनों मुझे नहीं पता था कि इसे सुकून कहते हैं। अब पता है, पर अब वक़्त नहीं है।
questions.question_en: What does the last line say about the writer now?
options: He no longer visits the village
He can name the thing now but no longer has it
questions.explanation_en: The whole piece is in the habitual past until the last two lines shift to the present, and that shift is the meaning.

questions.prompt_en: झिझक, समझ, माँग, पकड़, दौड़ — how are these nouns built?
options: from the bare verb stem, with nothing added
questions.explanation_en: The fifth way Hindi builds a feminine noun, after -आई, -ई, -ता and -ति — and this one adds nothing at all.

questions.prompt_en: फेंक देनी चाहिए थी means what?
options: I should have thrown it away, and did not
questions.explanation_en: चाहिए plus था is an obligation that was never met. The whole watch narrative turns on the gap between that line and the next.

questions.question_en: Which verb means to sustain something that could be dropped, rather than to finish it?
questions.explanation_en: You cannot निभाना a task, because a task ends. वादा, रिश्ता and ज़िम्मेदारी can all be dropped and are not being.

questions.prompt_en: What kind of object does बरतना take?
questions.explanation_en: सावधानी, संयम, एहतियात, नरमी — never a physical thing. Its narrowness is its whole usefulness.

questions.question_en: Which verb means to hold steadily, usually in support?
questions.explanation_en: पकड़ना seizes, थामना supports, संभालना takes charge. पुलिस ने चोर को थाम लिया would be almost comic.

checkpoints.title_en: The near-synonyms, and the last narratives

questions.question_en: Which verb for looking is neutral, with no attitude at all?
questions.explanation_en: निहारना is fond, ताकना intrusive, घूरना hostile. A scale of attitude built on one plain verb.

questions.prompt_en: बात मानना means what?
questions.explanation_en: जानना is to know, समझना to understand, मानना to accept or obey — three verbs English blurs into one region.

questions.prompt_en: Why does उम्दा not inflect when बड़ा does?
options: It is Perso-Arabic, and borrowed -आ adjectives stay fixed
It is only used with masculine nouns
questions.explanation_en: ताज़ा, ज़िंदा, बढ़िया behave the same way. The -आ ending misleads twice in this module, in opposite directions.

questions.question_en: Which of these is ambiguous between quickly and early?
questions.explanation_en: The everyday word is the vague one and the two formal words are each precise, which is the opposite of what learners expect.

questions.prompt_en: डर, भय and ख़ौफ़ — what is unusual about this three-way set?
options: All three are masculine, so only the setting differs
Only one is a real word
questions.explanation_en: Many pairs in this module change gender across the register. This set does not.

questions.prompt_en: In modern Hindi, धरना is mainly what?
options: a noun meaning a sit-in protest
questions.explanation_en: रखना took over the verb's work entirely. A word can be archaic in one part of speech and current in another.

questions.prompt_en: बेचैनी is built from which two parts?
options: It is not built from parts
questions.explanation_en: बे- is the seventh negating device in the module, and चैन is the word you met beside सुकून and शांति.

questions.prompt_en: अकेलापन, बचपन, अपनापन — what does -पन produce?
questions.explanation_en: Only the second masculine noun-maker in the module, after -आव, against five feminine ones.

questions.context_en: A narrative reads: उन्होंने कुछ नहीं पूछा — न नाम, न काम, न कहाँ से आया हूँ ... मैंने पैसे देने की कोशिश की। उन्होंने हाथ पकड़ लिया और मना कर दिया।
questions.question_en: What do the unasked questions and the refused money have in common?
options: Both refuse to make it a transaction — nothing is asked and nothing is owed
He wanted the visitor to leave
questions.explanation_en: Asking who somebody is, and being paid, are both ways of settling an account. The piece removes them one after the other.

questions.prompt_en: विदाई is built with which suffix, and what is notable about it?
options: -आई, and it is the module's last new word
-ई, the suffix taught in level 2 — the module's first pattern returning in its final word
questions.explanation_en: विदा plus -ई, feminine like every noun that suffix builds across all fifty-five levels.
